summary: Two churches. St. Joseph Pro-Cathedral: Sunday 8:00 AM (English), 11:00 AM and 1:30 PM (Spanish), Saturday 6:00 PM (Spanish; from two weeks of intentions plus the website, not in the page-1 box), and 8:00 AM bilingual daily Mass Monday-Saturday in the chapel; St. Anthony of Padua: Sunday 9:15 AM (Spanish). Also a dated November 19 7:00 PM Divine Providence Mass. Open: the website's self-contradictory weekday confession times (5 PM vs 9 AM), which no bulletin prints.
